description: This file defines the ProfilePage React component for a frontend web application. It includes UI elements and logic for loading, viewing, and updating user profile data, as well as changing passwords. It imports custom components and API functions, managing state and side effects relevant to profile management.

methods.name: ProfilePage
methods.description: React functional component that manages user profile display and editing, including password change functionality.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronous function to load user profile data by ID from the API.

methods.name: onSaveProfile
methods.description: Event handler to save updated profile information via API.

methods.name: onChangePassword
methods.description: Event handler to change user password via API.
